summary: useControllableState no longer reads or writes refs during render, so it passes eslint-plugin-react-hooks@7 `recommended` (react-hooks/refs) in consumer apps (#35). onChange is synced in an insertion effect; the controlled/uncontrolled switch warning moved to an effect; the setter depends on isControlled instead of a ref, so it is stable for every caller that does not switch modes (which already warns). The library now lints its own registry/ with the same preset, which also moved Calendar's focused-date correction from an effect to render-time derivation, useIsStuck's reset to its cleanup, and three ref-through-helper call sites (DatePicker, MultiSelect, CardSorting) to direct attributes.
